**Mhinduro [2 marks]:** **Dingindira renyaya (theme)** ndi**pfungwa huru kana chidzidzo chikuru chinobatanidza nyaya yese kubva pakutanga kusvika pakupedzisira—ndicho chinangwa chaidikanwa nemunyori kuti vaverengi vadzidze kubva murungano kana munyaya yacho**. Somuenzaniso, dingindira renyaya inotaura nezvemwana akashanda nesimba akazopedza chikoro nderekuti *kushanda nesimba nekutsungirira kunounza budiriro*.

Dingindira rakasiyana ne*pfupiso yezviitiko (plot)*: apo zviitiko zvinotaura kuti ndiani akaitei rinhi, **dingindira** rinodzidza chirevo chakadzika chehupenyu chiri shure kwechiitiko chacho—zvakaita se**rudo**, **kuremekedza**, **humbava hunopedzisira hwapinza mumatambudziko**, kana **kubatana mumhuri**.

MuBvunzo reZIMSEC ChiShona, nyora **pfungwa huru yenyaya** uchijekesa kuti ndicho chidzidzo chinofamba nenyaya yese, uye ipapo unogona kupa muenzaniso mupfupi wedingindira semubairo wakakwana.

**Cherechedzo yeMhinduro Yakazara:** Pakunyora mubvunzo unoti *"Ipa mhinduro yakazara muchiShona"*, nyora chirevo chizere chine zita nechiito pane kungopa izwi rimwe chete, kuti uwane zvibodzwa zvese zveZIMSEC 7040/2.

questions.questionText: Musiyano upi uri pakati pemutambi mukuru nemutambi mudiki munyaya?
questions.explanation:
**Mhinduro [3 marks]:** Musiyano uripo pakati pe**mutambi mukuru (main character / protagonist)** ne**mutambi mudiki (minor character)** munyaya ndewekuti: **mutambi mukuru** ndiye munhu anotungamirira nyaya yese, anowanikwa muzviitiko zvakawanda kubva pakutanga kusvika pakupedzisira, uye dingindira renyaya rinowanzonangana nedambudziko rake; **mutambi mudiki** anongobuda nguva diki mumitsara mishoma achibatsira kuburitsa unhu hwemutambi mukuru kana kutsigira chiitiko chimwe chete chinofambisa nyaya.

Somuenzaniso, munyaya yemwana anonzi Tendai anokunda bvunzo dzake nekushanda nesimba, **Tendai** ndiye **mutambi mukuru** nekuti zvinhu zvese zvinofamba maari, asi mutengesi wemabhuku kana mutyairi webhazi anomubatsira rimwe zuva chete vose **vatambi vadiki** vanongotsigira chiitiko chacho chete.

Kuti uwane zvibodzwa zvese zvitatu, ratidza musiyano wakajeka uchishandisa izwi rekuti *"asi"* kana *"pamusoro pezvo"*, uchienzanisa basa re**mutambi mukuru** nebasa re**mutambi mudiki** munyaya.

questions.questionText: Nyora zvinhu zvitatu zvinofanira kuwanikwa mutsamba yeshamwari.
questions.explanation:
**Mhinduro [4 marks]:** Zvinhu zvitatu zvikuru zvinofanira kuwanikwa **mutsamba yeshamwari (informal/friendly letter)** muChiShona ndezvi: **(1) Kero imwe chete yemunyori nezuva** (*writer's address and date*) pamusoro kurudyi rwepepa; **(2) Kukwazisa shamwari zvine mutsa** (*salutation*, sokuti *"Wadiwa Nyasha,"*) pamwe chete ne**mutumbi wetsamba** une ndima dzakajeka dzinotaura nyaya yemoyo; uye **(3) Mhedziso yeshamwari nezita rimwe chete remunyori** (*"Ndini wako anokuda, Rudo"*)**.

Tsamba yeshamwari inosiyana netsamba yebasa (*formal letter*) nekuti haina kero yechipiri yemunhu ari kunyorerwa uye haina musoro wenyaya (*subject heading*)—mutauro wayo une husahwira, hushamwari, nekukwazisa mhuri neshamwari zvinofadza. Ndima yekutanga inowanzo bvunza nezvehutano uye basa rechikoro shamwari isati yapinda muchinangwa chetsamba.

MuZIMSEC 7040/2 Rondedzero neTsamba, kukanganwa kero yemunyori pamusoro kurudyi kana kuisa kero mbiri mutsamba yeshamwari kunorasa zvibodzwa zvechimiro (*format marks*). Dzidzira kuronga **Kero + Zuva → Kukwazisa → Mutumbi → Mhedziso** nguva dzose.

questions.questionText: Taura zvinhu zvitatu zvinoita kuti rondedzero ive yakanaka.
questions.explanation:
**Mhinduro [4 marks]:** Zvinhu zvitatu zvinoita kuti **rondedzero (composition)** ive yepamusoro uye iwane zvibodzwa zvakawanda muZIMSEC ndezvi: **(1) Chimiro chakarongwa zvakanaka chine ndima dzakajeka** (*introduction, well-developed body paragraphs, and a strong conclusion*) dzinosimudzira pfungwa imwe chete pane imwe neimwe ndima; **(2) Mutauro weChiShona wakapfuma uye wakarurama** unoshandisa tsumo, madimikira, fananidzo, nyaudzosingwi (*ideophones* se*"akati tsvaa"*, *"vanhu vakati zii"*), nemazwi akakodzera pasina kudzosera; uye **(3) Manyorero akarurama ezvipauro, zvikomberedzo (*punctuation*), uye kuwirirana kwenguva yezviito (*tense consistency*)**.

Kana uchinyora rondedzero yeGrade 7, tanga nekugadzira hurongwa hwezvinhu zvauchataura kuitira kuti nyaya yako irege kuperera mudenga kana kubuda mubvunzo (*stay on topic*). Nyaudzosingwi netsumo zvinoiswa panzvimbo yazvo chaiyo zvinopa mutsara upenyu uye zvinonakidza mukorori.

questions.questionText: Shandisa izwi “shungu” mumutsara unonzwisisika.
questions.explanation:
**Mhinduro [2 marks]:** Mutsara wakanaka unoratidza zvinoreva izwi rekuti **"shungu"** ndiwo uyu: **Tatenda ane shungu dzekupasa bvunzo dzake dzeGrade 7 nedzidzo yepamusoro** (kana: *"Vabereki vedu vane shungu dzekutivakira imba yekuverengera pachikoro"*).

Izwi rekuti **shungu** rinoreva **chido chikuru chakadzika mumoyo chekuita kana kuwana chimwe chinhu** (*strong desire, determination, passion, or yearning*). Dzimwe nguva rinoshandiswawo pakutsanangura kutsamwa kana moyo unorema (*"ane shungu pamoyo"*), asi kuchikoro rinowanzo kurudzira **kushishita uye chido chekubudirira**.

questions.questionText: Nyora huwandu hwe “mwana” uye “mukadzi”.
questions.explanation:
**Mhinduro [2 marks]:** Huwandu (*plural form*) hwezita rekuti **mwana** ndi**vana**, uye huwandu hwezita rekuti **mukadzi** ndi**vakadzi** [2 marks]. (Mumutsara: *"Mwana mumwe anoimba, asi **vana** vazhinji vanotamba; **mukadzi** uyo anobika, uye **vakadzi** avo vanorima."*)

MuChiShona, mazita evanhu mumupanda wekutanga (*Class 1: mu-*) anoshanduka kuenda mumupanda wechipiri wehuwandu (*Class 2: va-*): naizvozvo **mu**-kadzi → **va**-kadzi, sekuti *mu-komana → va-komana* uye *mu-dzidzisi → va-dzidzisi*. Izwi rekuti **mwana** (*mu-ana*) rinonyungudika kuita *mwana* muhushoma, uye kana chivakashure chehuwandu **va-** chaiswa pamberi pa*-ana* (*va-ana*), chinobuda se**vana**.

Vadzidzi dzimwe nguva vanokanganisa vachiti *"mamwana"* kana *"vakamwana"*—zvose izvozvo hazvimo mumutauro wakarurama weChiShona. Rangarira nguva dzese kuti **mwana → vana**, **mukadzi → vakadzi**!

questions.questionText: Gadzira mibvunzo mitatu uchishandisa “ndiani”, “kupi” uye “riini”.
questions.explanation:
**Mhinduro [3 marks]:** Mibvunzo mitatu yakarurama inoshandisa mazwi ekubvunza aya ndeyiyi: **(1) Ndiani** — *Ndiani akatora bhuku rangu patafura?* (kubvunza nezvemunhu); **(2) Kupi** — *Amai vakaenda kupi mangwanani ano?* (kubvunza nezvenzvimbo); uye **(3) Riini** — *Bvunzo dzedu dzeGrade 7 dzichatanga riini?* (kubvunza nezvenguva) [3 marks].

Izwi rimwe nerimwe rekubvunza rine basa raro rakajeka mugirama yeChiShona: **ndiani** rinoshandiswa panotsvakwa munhu kana nyakuita; **kupi** rinobvunza nzvimbo yaenda kana pagara munhu/chinhu; uye **riini** rinobvunza zuva, nguva, kana mwaka uchaitika chiitiko. Cherechedza kuti mubvunzo wese weChiShona unofanira kupera ne**chikomba chemubvunzo (? — question mark)**.

Vadzidzi vanokanganwa kuisa **question mark (?)** pakuguma kwemutsara kana kusanganisa **kupi** (nzvimbo) na**riini** (nguva)—zvinoita kuti zvibodzwa zvedzidziso zvishomeke. Tarisa kuti mutsara wega wega une **?** uye unopindurika nemunhu, nzvimbo, kana nguva.

**Mhinduro [3 marks]:** Mibvunzo mitatu yakarurama inoshandisa mazwi ekubvunza aya ndeyiyi: **(1) Ndiani** — *Ndiani akatora bhuku rangu patafura?* (kubvunza nezvemunhu); **(2) Kupi** — *Amai vakaenda kupi mangwanani ano?* (kubvunza nezvenzvimbo); uye **(3) Riini** — *Bvunzo dzedu dzeGrade 7 dzichatanga riini?* (kubvunza nezvenguva) [3 marks].

Izwi rimwe nerimwe rekubvunza rine basa raro rakajeka mugirama yeChiShona: **ndiani** rinoshandiswa panotsvakwa munhu kana nyakuita; **kupi** rinobvunza nzvimbo yaenda kana pagara munhu/chinhu; uye **riini** rinobvunza zuva, nguva, kana mwaka uchaitika chiitiko. Cherechedza kuti mubvunzo wese weChiShona unofanira kupera ne**chikomba chemubvunzo (? — question mark)**.

Vadzidzi vanokanganwa kuisa **question mark (?)** pakuguma kwemutsara kana kusanganisa **kupi** (nzvimbo) na**riini** (nguva)—zvinoita kuti zvibodzwa zvedzidziso zvishomeke. Tarisa kuti mutsara wega wega une **?** uye unopindurika nemunhu, nzvimbo, kana nguva.

**Cherechedzo yeMhinduro Yakazara:** Pakunyora mubvunzo unoti *"Ipa mhinduro yakazara muchiShona"*, nyora chirevo chizere chine zita nechiito pane kungopa izwi rimwe chete, kuti uwane zvibodzwa zvese zveZIMSEC 7040/2.

questions.questionText: Ronga mashoko aya kuti ave mutsara wakarurama: “chikoro / vanoenda / vana / mangwanani”.
questions.explanation:
**Mhinduro [2 marks]:** Kana mashoko aya akarongwa zvakarurama, mutsara unobuda unoti: **Vana vanoenda kuchikoro mangwanani** (kana uchishandisa chaicho izwi riri mubvunzo: **Vana vanoenda chikoro mangwanani**, nechiShona chakanaka chinowedzera chivakashure chokuenda *ku-*: **Vana vanoenda kuchikoro mangwanani**).

Kuronga mashoko kuti aumbe mutsara une musoro kunotevera mutemo weChiShona we**Mutambi + Chiito + Nzvimbo + Nguva (SVO + Time)**: **Vana** (mutambi / *subject*) + **vanoenda** (chiito / *verb* chine wirirano ya*va-*) + **kuchikoro** (nzvimbo / *place*) + **mangwanani** (nguva / *time*). Kutanga na *"Vana"* kunoratidza nevara guru (*capital V*) uye mutsara unopera nechinhu chekugumisa (*full stop*).

Usaende pakunyora *"Mangwanani kuchikoro vana vanoenda"* sezvo chisiri chimiro chechinyorwa cheGrade 7 chinowanzo bvunzwa. Isa **Vana** pakutanga, **vanoenda** pachipiri, uchiteverwa nenzvimbo uye nguva.

questions.questionText: Dudzira muchiShona: “Hard work brings success.”
questions.explanation:
**Mhinduro [2 marks]:** Dudziro yakarurama yeChiShona yemutsara wekuti *"Hard work brings success"* ndeyekuti: **Kushanda nesimba kunounza budiriro** (kana kuti: *"Basa rakaoma / kushanda nesimba kunobereka kubudirira"*) [2 marks].

Pachidudziro (*translation*) kubva kuChirungu kuenda kuChiShona, tinofananidza zvinoreva chirevo chose pane kududzira izwi rimwe nerimwe zvakaoma: *"Hard work"* = **kushanda nesimba**; *"brings"* = **kunounza** (chiito chinoenderana nechinhu chisingabatanidzi *ku-*); uye *"success"* = **budiriro / kubudirira**. Tsika yeChiShona inosimbisa pfungwa iyi netsumo yokuti *"Hapana chinouya usina kushandira"* kana *"Simba mukaka rinozvisunga."*

MuZIMSEC 7040/2, dudziro dzinoda ChiShona chakanaka chinoerera pasina mazwi eChirungu akaiswa mukati (kwete *"kushanda hard"*). Nyora mutsara wakazara **Kushanda nesimba kunounza budiriro.**

questions.questionText: Wedzera chivakashure chakakodzera kuti uwane izwi rinoreva munhu anodzidzisa.
questions.explanation:
**Mhinduro [2 marks]:** Chivakashure chinowanzowedzerwa pachiratidzo chechiito *-dzidzisa* kuti chive zita rinoreva **munhu anodzidzisa** ndi**mu-** (pamwe nekuchinja magumo *-a* kuva *-i*), zvichiita izwi rekuti **mudzidzisi** (huwandu: **vadzidzisi**) [2 marks].

Mugirama yeChiShona, mazita emabasa evanhu (**agent nouns**) anovakwa kubva kuzviito (*verbs*) nekuisa chivakashure chemunhu **mu-** pamberi pemudzi wechiito uye shanduko *-i* pakuguma: *-dzidza* (learn) → **mudzidzi** (learner); *-dzidzisa* (teach) → **mudzidzisi** (teacher); *-rima* (farm) → **murimi** (farmer); *-bika* → **mubiki**.

Usanyora *"mudzidza"* (ndiye anofunda) kana *"chikoro"* (ndiyo nzvimbo). Kana mubvunzo ukabvunza **munhu anodzidzisa**, mhinduro ndeyekuti **mu-** + dzidzisa → **mudzidzisi**.
